summary: Jeffrey Ashby fell about 500 feet while descending La Plata Peak after summiting; he broke both legs and one arm; a local SAR member stayed with him overnight; a HAATS Black Hawk hoisted him on July 16
responding_agency: Colorado Army National Guard HAATS, local search and rescue team
